description.short: Climb Snowdon is a guided walking company based in Gwynedd, offering open-group and private guided ascents of Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon) on all six summit paths. Founded in 2014, they operate with qualified Mountain Leaders at a 1:10 ratio and include photography, safety equipment, and post-event support.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website content. Needs editorial review.
description.full:
Climb Snowdon is the trading name of RAW Adventures Mountain Activities Ltd, a guided walking company founded in 2014 by Ross and Kate Worthington and based at Yr Hen Ysgol, Brynrefail, Gwynedd, LL55 3NR. Their team holds over 40 years of combined UK mountain leading experience.

The company operates open-group guided walks, private walks (1–4 people), school trips, and corporate away-days to the summit of Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon). Open Day departures run on all six main Snowdon paths: the Ranger Path, Llanberis Path, Miners' Track, Rhyd Ddu Path, Pyg Track, and Watkin Path. Specialist experiences include Snowdon by Night, sunrise and sunset walks, the Crib Goch scramble, the Snowdon Horseshoe, Sea to Summit, Snowdon Skyline, '360' (a circuit combining multiple ridges), and '6' (all six Snowdon paths in one day).

A qualified Mountain Leader accompanies every group at a maximum 1:10 ratio. Each booking includes safety equipment and first aid, event notes and kit list, photographs from the day, and post-event support. The company is a certified B Corporation and a Living Wage Employer, and donates £1 per walker to the Snowdonia Society conservation charity. Their Charity Partner Programme has raised over £308,000 for partner charities to date.
